periods.time: Stella rescue crisis and postwar wedding planning
periods.label: 地下国王的冷静判断

name.jp: アストレア・ヴァーミリオン

personality.summary: Astrea is perceptive, politically sharp and candid. She doubts Itsuki because of past Kurogane conduct, but apologizes once she understands his parental and political resolve.
flaws: initial suspicion of Itsuki due to his reputation and past conduct

relationships.stella-vermillion: Daughter whose danger she grasps immediately as not protected by hostage logic.
relationships.sirius-vermillion: Husband; has him removed from the call when rage prevents discussion.
relationships.itsuki-kurogane: Negotiates with him and apologizes for mistrusting his intent.
relationships.lunaeyes-vermillion: Daughter present during the crisis call.
relationships.john-cobland: Asks him to restrain Sirius so the adults can speak.

periods.summary: Astrea takes over the call with Itsuki after Sirius erupts, immediately recognizing that Itsuki contacted Vermillion before the Union meeting for a strategic reason, not mere courtesy. She understands that if Eilands acts for personal goals, Stella's safety is not protected by hostage bargaining, and that Union procedure would waste time. She questions why Japan would risk so much for Stella, then accepts Itsuki's answer and apologizes for assuming he was rigid and unfeeling. Later, she is implied to be central to the swift wedding arrangements and rumored political motive of securing Ikki for Vermillion before other countries court him.

key_events.summary: Calmly negotiates with Itsuki over Union strategy for rescuing Stella.
Is associated with the rapid arrangement of Ikki and Stella's Vermillion wedding.
